{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Columbia Gulf Transmission Pipeline''' is a natural gas pipeline in the United States, with 3 segments.

==Location==
Maysville Project: The pipeline is proposed to run from Columbia Gulf mainline tie-in, Rowan County, Kentucky to North Maysville delivery meter station, Hugh L. Spurlock Power Station, Mason County, Kentucky.<ref name="rec4e8b">{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-01-20/pdf/2026-00985.pdf|title=Federal Register, Vol. 91, No. 12, 20 January 2026, Notices|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref name="r30800f">{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, August 2026 release, U.S. Energy Information Administration|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
Pulaski Project: The pipeline is proposed to run from Columbia Gulf mainline, Lincoln County, Kentucky to South Somerset Delivery Meter Station, Pulaski County, Kentucky.<ref name="r06c39f">{{Cite web|url=https://public-inspection.federalregister.gov/2025-23711.pdf|title=Federal Register notice, Docket No. CP26-11-000, published 23 December 2025|website=public-inspection.federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref name="r097e76">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/news-events/events/scoping-meeting-pulaski-project-cp26-11-000-somerset-ky-11242025|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
Vicksburg Lateral: The pipeline runs from Columbia Gulf mainline, Richland Parish, Louisiana to Baxter Wilson Plant and Warren Power Plant interconnections, Warren County, Mississippi.<ref name="r370942">{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2000-11-16/pdf/00-29347.pdf|title=Federal Register, Vol. 65, No. 222, 16 November 2000, Notices|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Background==
===Maysville Project===
Columbia Gulf Transmission applied to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission in November 2025 to build the Maysville Project. A notice from January 2026 sets the schedule for the environmental review.<ref name="rec4e8b" />

The project would add 42 miles of new 30-inch pipe in Rowan, Fleming and Mason Counties, Kentucky. It would end at a new meter station at the Spurlock Power Station.<ref name="rec4e8b" /> It would carry 340,000 dekatherms per day.<ref name="r9c1e98" /> The Energy Information Administration lists a 2029 start and a cost of $400 million.<ref name="r30800f" />

===Pulaski Project===
Columbia Gulf Transmission filed an application with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission on 15 October 2025 to build the Pulaski Project. It would add 41.3 miles of new 30-inch pipe from Lincoln County to a new South Somerset meter station in Pulaski County, Kentucky.<ref name="r06c39f" />

The pipe would deliver 260,000 dekatherms per day to East Kentucky Power Cooperative's Cooper power station.<ref name="r06c39f" /> The same Energy Information Administration list gives this project a 2029 start and a $400 million cost.<ref name="r30800f" />

===Vicksburg Lateral===
The Vicksburg Lateral was built to supply two power plants. A November 2000 notice describes about 37 miles of 20-inch pipe from the Columbia Gulf main line in Richland Parish, Louisiana, to the Baxter Wilson Plant and the proposed Warren Power Plant in Warren County, Mississippi. It would carry up to 285,000 dekatherms per day at an estimated cost of $20.1 million.<ref name="r370942" />

The Energy Information Administration lists the lateral as completed in September 2001.<ref name="r30800f" />

===Main Line===
TC Energy describes the Columbia Gulf Transmission Pipeline as a system stretching 3,367 miles. It connects to virtually every major pipeline on the U.S. Gulf Coast and to additional Midwestern lines.<ref name="r8b74a3" /> TC Energy says the natural gas that heats homes and businesses in Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee and Kentucky is often supplied by the pipeline.<ref name="r8b74a3" /> It is regulated by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.<ref name="r8b74a3" />
